for ATTEMPT in 1 2 3; do
  echo "=== Percobaan build ke-$ATTEMPT ===" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
  set +e
  flutter build apk --${BUILD_MODE} --split-per-abi > /tmp/attempt.log 2>&1
  CODE=$?
  set -e
  cat /tmp/attempt.log | tee -a /tmp/build.log
  if [ "$CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Build sukses!" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
    exit 0
  fi

  FIXED=0

  # Fix 1: Gradle project lebih rendah dari minimum Flutter, naikin versi wrapper
  if grep -q "minimum supported version of" /tmp/attempt.log; then
    NEED=$(grep -oE "minimum supported version of [0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?" /tmp/attempt.log | tail -n 1 | grep -oE "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?" || true)
    NEED=$(echo "$NEED" | sed -E 's/^([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)\.0$/\1/')
    if [ -n "$NEED" ] && [ -f android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties ]; then
      echo "Naikin Gradle ke $NEED otomatis" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
      sed -i -E "s#^distributionUrl=.*#distributionUrl=https\\\\://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-${NEED}-all.zip#" android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties
      FIXED=1
    fi
  fi

  # Fix 2: AGP 9 + newDsl, matiin newDsl biar kode project lama tetep kebaca
  if grep -q "android.newDsl" /tmp/attempt.log && ! grep -q "^android.newDsl=false" android/gradle.properties 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Matiin android.newDsl otomatis" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
    printf '\nandroid.newDsl=false\n' >> android/gradle.properties
    FIXED=1
  fi

  if [ "$FIXED" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Nggak ada perbaikan otomatis yang cocok, berhenti di sini" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
    exit 1
  fi
done
echo "Udah 3x nyoba tapi tetep gagal" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
exit 1
